status: Measurement only. The owner approved the recommended next step ("ok continue with your recs", 29 October 2026): make reference sheets for the most frequent recurring cast, then re-check Daniel, the one measured character without a sheet.
purpose: Daniel's four consistency-group verses through the live pipeline in each public style, now that production has his sheet, to compare his same-person rate with the 3 of 12 measured without it.
design: Changes as little as possible from the earlier images except the sheet. Each style family gets its own memory store, seeded from a fresh read-only production snapshot (which now holds Daniel's sheet) plus the section looks his earlier images were drawn with: the third launch matrix for Classical and Watercolor, the Fresco matrix for Fresco. A look is seeded only when its section and cast versions are unchanged. The stores run one after the other, because the engine shares in-flight preparations across a process. Each case is prepared once per store; every first image is checked and a faulty one gets one retry. Cases run three at a time.
scoring: Pairs per ADR 0008 with npm run evals:consistency over this run alone, so only the Daniel and lions' den groups are read. Two independent blind model scorers and operator settlement; the clarified scoring rule applies.
knownLimitation: One image per verse and style, and new plans: a before-and-after on 12 to 18 pairs, not a controlled test of the sheet alone.
